title.narrative: Thailand Refrigeration and Air Conditioning NAMA (RAC NAMA)

description.narrative: The project aimed at leapfrogging technological developments in the refrigeration and air conditioning (RAC) sector: 1. shaping the policy and regulatory framework; 2. supporting the production and assembly of local green RAC equipment; 3. preparing the service sector; and 4. supporting the market introduction. It transformed the production and use of RAC appliances for both the domestic and commercial sectors. Manufacturers were able to produce climate-friendly and competitive products for the domestic and export markets. This entailed new jobs and training for technicians and lower energy and refrigerant bills for consumers. The project bundled and leveraged financial mechanisms to promote climate-friendly and energy-efficient RAC devices, e.g., through the RAC NAMA Revolving Fund. RAC equipment introduced within the project period cut emissions by over 1.05 Mt CO2e over the project's duration. 270,900 persons directly benefited from the project.
